item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 example of Jokowi personally retracting a specific false factual claim in a way that is clearly about truthfulness, not just generic apology. I also found no clean 2024 case where Jokowi personally ordered punishment of a named whistleblower for exposing a falsehood. The best negative evidence is institutional and indirect, especially media restrictions, harassment, and coercive crowd control. So the evidence is strongest for “allowed some correction and apology, but operated inside a system that often constrained truthful reporting and tolerated pressure on critics,” rather than for a clean, truth-protecting record.","evidence":[{"title":"Presiden Jokowi: Saya Tidak Sempurna, Saya Manusia Biasa","publisher":"Presidency of Indonesia","date":"2024-08-01","url":"https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-saya-tidak-sempurna-saya-manusia-biasa/","summary":"Jokowi publicly apologized for mistakes and shortcomings in office.
